issues.detail: Spec S04 shows q=x at time 0 before any posedge; contract reset kind none with q null and uncertain global note, but no rule covers initial x state.
Rule condition 'a==1 or previous a==0' does not match spec: at 45ns a=0 prev a=1 and q holds at 4, which is increment condition not hold. Quote is from a=0 falling edge.
Rule condition 'a==0 and previous a==1' matches 55ns, but example vectors [1,0,0] expected [4,5,5] imply increment on first a=0 after a=1, yet spec at 45ns a=0 prev a=1 holds at 4, contradicting.

Spec waveform: q=4 from 5ns through 50ns while a=1 then a=0 at 45ns; increment occurs at 55ns (a=0 prev a=0), not on falling edge. Contract says increment on falling transition (prev a=1, a=0), which would increment at 45ns.

Alternative semantics: q increments on posedge when a==0 regardless of previous a (not falling-edge). This fits 55ns increment (a=0 prev a=0) and 45ns hold (a=0 prev a=1 would increment under this alternative, so actually contradicts). Better alternative: increment on posedge when a==0 and previous a==0? Check 55ns prev a=0 yes, 45ns prev a=1 no hold, 65ns prev a=0 increment, 75ns prev a=0 increment to 0 (wrap), 85ns prev a=0 increment to 1. Fits all.
issues.alternative: increment when a==0 and previous a==0 (i.e., second consecutive low), hold otherwise

issues.detail: Derived spec outputs: posedge at 5ns a=1 q=4; 15ns a=1 q=4; 25ns a=1 q=4; 35ns a=1 q=4; 45ns a=0 prev a=1 q=4 (hold); 55ns a=0 prev a=0 q=5 (increment); 65ns a=0 prev a=0 q=6; 75ns a=0 prev a=0 q=0 (wrap); 85ns a=0 prev a=0 q=1. Contract falling-edge rule would give q=5 at 45ns, contradicting spec.

Rule example vectors [1,1,1] expected [4,4,4] is consistent with hold when a=1, but rule condition also includes previous a==0 which would hold on first a=1 after a=0; spec at 5ns first posedge a=1 q=4 (initial x to 4) not clearly hold.
Spec S03-S22 are waveform comments; contract maps them to rules but no rule explicitly covers wrap from 6 to 0 at 75ns or 0 to 1 at 85ns beyond generic increment.
